2.t: striking sparks of fire ˹with their hoofs˺

5.t: and penetrating into the heart of enemy lines

6.t: Surely humankind is ungrateful to their Lord—

7.t: and they certainly attest to this—

8.t: and they are truly extreme in their love of ˹worldly˺ gains

9.t: Do they not know that when the contents of the graves will be spilled out
9.tr: Afala ya'lamu iza b'uthira ma fil quboor

10.t: and the secrets of the hearts will be laid bare—

11.t: surely their Lord is All-Aware of them on that Day
